extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.20.0 Sleep timer: fix pulsating screensaver; add Screen off (CEC) and Screen off (Android/Google TV) options alongside screensaver modes; numeric keypad for custom duration; last-used custom value shown in presets. Widget URLs with trailing slash now resolve correctly. Remove Comment label from book/episode info dialogs. Podcast and Author items now show info on the i button.
